name: ranarch-installer-ui
description: RanArch Installer — .deb / .rpm 安装器的桌面前端

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.dist: npm run stage:backend && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:appimage: npm run stage:backend && npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage

linux.synopsis: 在 Arch Linux 及衍生系上直接安装 deb / rpm 包
linux.description: RanArch Installer 的图形前端：把 .deb / .rpm 拖进来即可安装，带签名校验、冲突与依赖检查、沙箱试装和实时终端输出。

desktop.Comment: 安装 deb / rpm 软件包
